retired_surfaces.rationale: The local Iced viewport type and duplicate algorithm were replaced by the shared zhuge-ui-core VirtualWindow and its bounded fixed-extent geometry.
Variable-extent prefix indexing moved to the shared toolkit-neutral zhuge-ui-core owner as VariableExtentIndex; Bevy retains only scroll physics, identity, and entity-recycling adapters.
The ambiguous dynamic-row constructor was replaced by the explicit new_variable_extent typed mode.
The boolean measurement result was replaced by RowMeasurementOutcome and shared ExtentUpdate typed outcomes.
The setter could silently replace a measured variable index; set_fixed_extent now reports when the selected height mode rejects the operation.
The unused list-local physics implementation was retired; Bevy ScrollArea owns touch drag and bounded coast motion.
The unused list-local fling API duplicated touch drag/coast motion owned by the ScrollArea adapter.
The unused list-specific fling message was retired; ScrollArea gesture input is the sole product scroll-motion path.
The unused list-local physics update API was retired; the ScrollArea adapter owns typed touch/coast transitions.
The unused second list motion API was retired; list geometry remains in the shared UI core and gesture motion in ScrollArea.
The process-global VPN state holder was replaced by the typed VPN lifecycle coordinator and host authorization flow.
The unproduced UI delay command was removed with the old dispatch path after typed outbound probing became the supported behavior.
The unproduced node-delay command was removed with the old dispatch path after typed outbound probing became the supported behavior.
The CLI proxy parser was retired when the command surface moved to typed outbound operations.
The former CLI group-list command was replaced by `outbound list`.
The former CLI proxy-switch command was replaced by typed `outbound select`.
The former CLI proxy listing command was replaced by typed `outbound list`.
The former CLI delay-test command was replaced by typed `outbound probe`.
The former CLI current-proxy query was replaced by typed `outbound list` selection readback.
The erased Bevy host-composition entry had no production consumer and was replaced by injected host-owned SurfaceSource and UiCommandSink composition.
Android product control now enters through the typed owner IPC UiCommandSink; Bevy UI no longer accepts the AndroidControlApplication host adapter.
The convenience constructor created an application command sink inside the Bevy UI crate and had no production consumer; hosts now inject UiCommandSink explicitly.
Android lifecycle control is handled by the NativeActivity owner's typed IPC client rather than an application control adapter attached to a Bevy UI sink.
The UI surface contract no longer exposes an application-owned scope lock; owner snapshots carry their accepted scope and hosts provide typed command clients.
Cross-surface fixture identities moved from host composition into the shared contract so UI packages no longer depend on runtime composition for demo literals.
The cross-surface byte display helper moved from the application layer to the runtime-neutral shared presentation utilities; the application-owned module is retired.
Pure cross-surface shell readout copy and status folding moved to infiltrator-presentation; application no longer owns this view-only module.
The pure traffic readout reducer and freshness result moved to infiltrator-presentation, removing this view-only reducer from application.
The connection-rate boolean was replaced by the shared ConnectionRateObservation enum so an unmeasured rate cannot masquerade as a measured zero.
The settings module was replaced by the engine-neutral runtime_settings owner and Core-only versioned persistence migration.
The unvalidated settings DTO was replaced by validated RuntimeProbeSettings shared by the settings owner and all surfaces.
The duplicated raw draft was replaced by RuntimeProbeSettingsDraft and the shared settings editor state model.
The mixed options/boolean/failure snapshot was replaced by RuntimeProbeSettingsState with explicit Available and Unavailable cases.
The probe default moved under the typed RuntimeProbeSettings owner; its old unscoped constant is retired.
The engine-specific signed timeout cap now belongs to the Mihomo adapter instead of the neutral contract.
The old command was replaced by SetRuntimeProbeSettings carrying the validated canonical value.
The URL/duration/bandwidth DTO and duplicate core speedtester were replaced by the accepted RuntimeProbeSettings owner and typed multi-round SpeedtestTarget contract.
The name-keyed throughput report was replaced by typed OutboundId results retaining per-round sample outcomes, jitter, and loss semantics.
String proxy names and priority scheduling were replaced by a validated typed target tied to an accepted inventory revision and scope.
This unused core implementation was retired; SpeedtestApplication now performs preflight-fenced multi-round Outbound probes with typed cancellation, timeout, and sample outcomes.
String scope identity was replaced by OutboundProbeBatchScope carried inside a CoreScope- and inventory-revision-fenced SpeedtestTarget.
The raw config was replaced by validated SpeedtestTarget and accepted RuntimeProbeSettings owners.
Name-keyed node rows were replaced by SpeedtestOutboundResult keyed by engine-owned OutboundId.
Speedtest no longer infers egress location from display names or joins speedtest rows to adapter egress; only typed outbound observations remain authoritative.
The domain-owned legacy result was replaced by the shared typed Outbound speedtest result and sample outcome contract.
The domain calculator was replaced by JitterCalculation over preserved multi-round typed samples in the neutral contract.
The name-based command was replaced by StartSpeedtest carrying a typed SpeedtestTarget.
The string message was replaced by the typed StartSpeedtest surface intent built from the accepted outbound inventory.
The UI-facing speedtest port was retired; CoreApplication now owns run admission, cancellation, completion fencing, and the canonical snapshot.
HostRuntime no longer exposes a second speedtest owner; product surfaces submit Core intents and read the Core-authored snapshot.
The desktop-specific speedtest adapter was removed with the direct host port; speedtests now use the shared Core application path.
The per-surface unsupported port was removed; unsupported scheduling is represented by typed Core runtime admission outcomes.
The run-ambiguous cancellation command was replaced by CancelSpeedtestRun carrying the admitted SpeedtestRunId.
UI-pushed speedtest snapshots were retired; Iced now reads the Core owner snapshot after typed command receipts.
UI composition no longer injects an independent speedtest application; CoreApplication owns the shared speedtest service.
Cancellation now distinguishes an already-finished run from an unknown/stale run using RunAlreadyFinished and StaleRun.
The old delay loop API was replaced by the Core-owned prepared run and executor-neutral task scheduler.
The direct node probe API was replaced by preflight-fenced typed outbound probes owned by SpeedtestApplication.
The legacy bandwidth recorder was retired; speedtest results are recorded as typed outbound observations and samples.
The UI-side outbound IP mutation hook was retired; results are recorded under the Core owner and its accepted run identity.
History reads now come from the Core-authored SpeedtestSnapshot instead of a UI-owned getter surface.
The direct UniFFI read entry was retired; Compose now reads revisioned TUN state through the typed :vpn owner operation.
The direct UniFFI write entry was retired; TUN writes now use typed owner operation readback and the shared owner data revision.
The direct WebDAV UniFFI read entry was retired; Compose reads the revision-fenced settings snapshot through AndroidOwnerOperation.
The direct WebDAV UniFFI write entry was retired; settings writes now return the owner snapshot and advance the owner data revision.
The direct WebDAV connection-test entry was retired; tests now carry a typed operation result and accepted owner settings snapshot.
The direct WebDAV sync entry was retired; sync-now now returns a typed summary with the owner snapshot and revision.
